# Arm viewer third-party modules

- Three.js 0.184.0 — https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.184.0 — MIT — https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- urdf-loader 0.13.1 — https://www.npmjs.com/package/urdf-loader/v/0.13.1 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/gkjohnson/urdf-loaders
